arxiv-2210-00836.creator: P. Naumov 2 , S. Silaeva 1 , V. Sinev 1,2 , A. Vlasenko 1,2
arxiv-2210-00836.description: Abstract New antineutrino spectra of fissile isotopes ( 235 U, 238 U, 239 Pu and 241 Pu) which are containing in a nuclear reactor fuel have been obtained. A combined technique was used: calculation of antineutrino spectra and their fitting to those obtained in the experiment at the Rovno NPP in the 80s of the last century.

arxiv-2312-14311.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Isaiah A. Moses, Chengyin Wu, Wesley F. Reinhart. Materials characterization remains a labor-intensive process, with a large amount of expert time required to post-process and analyze micrographs. As a result, machine learning has become an essential tool in materials science, including for materials characterization. arxiv-2404-13828.title: Unique multistable states in periodic structures with saturable nonlinearity. II. Broken 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} -symmetric regime
arxiv-2404-13828.creator: S. Vignesh Raja, A. Govindarajan, M. Lakshmanan
arxiv-2404-13828.description: Abstract In this work, we observe that the 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} -symmetric fiber Bragg gratings (PTFBGs) with saturable nonlinearity (SNL) exhibit ramp-like, mixed, optical multistability (OM) in the broken regime. The interplay between nonlinearity and detuning parameter plays a central role in transforming the characteristics of the hysteresis curves and facilitates the realization of different OM curves.

arxiv-2408-11783.title: Two relaxation mechanisms for rejuvenation of stable polystyrene glass
arxiv-2408-11783.creator: Saba Karimi, Junjie Yin, James A. Forrest
arxiv-2408-11783.description: Abstract We report on the rejuvenation of thin films of polystyrene (PS) as they are heated from stable glassy states - prepared either through vapour deposition or physical aging. For films with thickness h ≳ 200 h\gtrsim 200 nm, the rejuvenation of vapour deposited stable PS glass films follow behaviour well-documented for other stable glasses.

arxiv-2502-10875.title: A Geometric Approach to Personalized Recommendation with Set-Theoretic Constraints Using Box Embeddings
arxiv-2502-10875.creator: Shib Dasgupta, Michael Boratko, Andrew McCallum
arxiv-2502-10875.description: Abstract Personalized item recommendation typically suffers from data sparsity, which is most often addressed by learning vector representations of users and items via low-rank matrix factorization. While this effectively densifies the matrix by assuming users and movies can be represented by linearly dependent latent features, it does not capture more complicated interactions.

arxiv-2503-24297.title: Dynamical properties of particulate composites derived from ultradense stealthy hyperuniform sphere packings
arxiv-2503-24297.creator: Carlo Vanoni, Jaeuk Kim, Paul J. Steinhardt, Salvatore Torquato
arxiv-2503-24297.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Carlo Vanoni, Jaeuk Kim, Paul J. Steinhardt, Salvatore Torquato. Stealthy hyperuniform (SHU) many-particle systems are distinguished by a structure factor that vanishes not only at zero wave number (as in “standard” hyperuniform systems) but also across an extended range of wave numbers near the origin. We generate disordered SHU packings of identical and ‘nonoverlapping’ spheres in d d -dimensional Euclidean space using a modified collective-coordinate optimization algorithm that incorporates a soft-core repulsive potential between particles in addition to the standard stealthy pair potential.

arxiv-2506-23125.title: Learning Motion Skills with Adaptive Assistive Curriculum Force in Humanoid Robots
arxiv-2506-23125.creator: Zhanxiang Cao, Yang Zhang, Buqing Nie, Huangxuan Lin, Haoyang Li, Yue Gao
arxiv-2506-23125.description: Abstract Learning policies for complex humanoid tasks remains both challenging and compelling. Inspired by how infants and athletes rely on external support—such as parental walkers or coach-applied guidance—to acquire skills like walking, dancing, and performing acrobatic flips, we propose A2CF : Adaptive Assistive Curriculum Force for humanoid motion learning.

pmc-11664111.title: Topical Tacrolimus in Vitiligo: Consensus Paper from the Pigmentary Disorders Society
pmc-11664111.creator: Rashmi Sarkar, Sunil Dogra, Keshavamurthy Vinay, Surabhi Sinha, Vignesh R Narayan, Muthu Sendhil Kumaran, Indrashis Podder, Soumya Jagadeesan, Mala Bhalla, Anupam Das, Ridhima Lakhani, Richa Sharma, Shyamanta Barua, Vijay K Somani, D M Thappa, Venkataram Mysore, Bhavesh Swarnkar
pmc-11664111.description: BackgroundTacrolimus, a topical calcineurin inhibitor (TCI) with immunomodulatory effects, is considered a viable treatment option for vitiligo. A consensus building exercise was undertaken to determine the role and clinical utility of topical tacrolimus in the management of vitiligo using input from experts in the field of dermatology.MethodsSeventeen experts collaborated to create consensus statements using a modified Delphi methodology.

pmc-12619989.title: Genome Sequencing to Prevent Hospital-Acquired Infections Caused by Carbapenem-Resistant Acinetobacter baumannii Due to Importation and Intra-facility Transmission in a Regional Hospital Network: Study Protocol for Implementation Research
pmc-12619989.creator: Basanti Pathi, Jyoti Prakash Sahoo, Ashoka Mahapatra, Rajashree Panigrahy, Sanghamitra Padhi, Priya Ranjan Lenka, Indrani Mohanty, Balamurugan Ramadass, Kumudini Panigrahi, Shikha Dixit, Manoja K Das
pmc-12619989.description: Background and objectives: Carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (CRAb) is among India's leading bacteria responsible for hospital-acquired infections (HAIs). The CRAb causing intra-facility and inter-facility (or importation) HAI transmissions may differ phylogenetically. For control and prevention of CRAb-associated HAIs within and across facilities, information about the phylogenetic lineage characterization and contextual risk factors is critical.

pmc-12715209.title: Mapping electric fields and observation of ferroelectric domain switching in hafnia-zirconia devices by electron holography
pmc-12715209.creator: Leifeng Zhang, Christophe Gatel, Muhammad Hamid Raza, Kilian Gruel, Catherine Dubourdieu, Martin Hÿtch
pmc-12715209.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Ferroelectric devices such as capacitors, tunnel junctions and field-effect transistors rely on the reversible switching of polarisation under an electric field, which strongly depends on the screening charges at the interfaces. Despite the crucial role of charge trapping and detrapping on the performance of ferroelectric devices, current understanding relies heavily on electrical measurements of the whole device and/or local analysis of the atomic polarisation and structure.

pmc-13172322.title: Lymphodepleting preconditioning impairs host antitumor immunity induced by adoptive T cell therapy in mouse models
pmc-13172322.creator: Diego Figueroa, Juan Pablo Vega, Andrés Hernández-Oliveras, Felipe Ardiles, Sofía Hidalgo, Ximena López, Vicente Saavedra, Catalina Bustamante, Daniela Malavé, Felipe Flores, Felipe Gálvez-Cancino, Hugo Gonzalez, Manuel Varas-Godoy, Maria Rosa Bono, Fabiola Osorio, Vincenzo Borgna, Alvaro Lladser
pmc-13172322.description: Adoptive T cell therapy (ACT) is effective against hematologic cancers, but the mechanisms underlying durable responses in solid tumors remain unclear. We show that adoptively transferred CD8+ T cells that eradicate established murine tumors promote expansion of host CD8+ T cells exhibiting tumor-reactive and tissue-resident phenotypes that contribute to tumor elimination.

pmc-13612817.creator: Ching-Wei Tu, Ho-Li Wang
pmc-13612817.description: Background/ObjectivesColorectal cancer (CRC) is influenced by genetic, environmental, and dietary factors, with increasing evidence highlighting the role of the gut microbiota in its development. pmc-13700365.creator: Maryam Peimani, Anita L. Stewart, Ensieh Nasli-Esfahani
pmc-13700365.description: ObjectiveTo examine a moderated mediation model in which shared decision-making (SDM) mediates the association between patient–physician communication (PPC) and two key diabetes outcomes—medication adherence and diabetes distress— while physician empathy moderates the pathways from PPC to SDM and from SDM to outcomes.MethodsA cross-sectional survey of 1300 adults with diabetes was conducted at a specialty clinic in Tehran, Iran.

uslaw-usc-t33-s568.title: 33 U.S.C. § 568 — Limitation on power of committee of Congress to consider projects
uslaw-usc-t33-s568.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s568.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 12 (River And Harbor Improvements Generally); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No project shall be considered by any committee of Congress with a view to its adoption, except with a view to a survey, if five years have elapsed since a report upon a survey of such project.
